shortDescription: Create, read, and update the interface settings for a Linode instance.

options.name: default_route
options.description: Interfaces used for the IPv4 default_route and IPv6 default_route when multiple interfaces are eligible for the role.

options.name: linode_id
options.description: The ID of the instance to configure the interface settngs for.

options.name: network_helper
options.description: Enables the Network Helper feature. The default value is determined by the network_helper setting in the account settings. Power off the Linode before disabling or enabling Network Helper.
